description: Whether the signed-in user has connected Google Calendar to TaskLite, which Google account, and what the connection may do: canWriteOwnCalendars (add, change and delete events in the calendars TaskLite creates in that account), canReadBusy (read when the person is already busy in their other calendars, a second consent), needsReconnect (Google stopped accepting it: a new google_calendar_connect link is needed). The connection belongs to the user, not to an app: every app of the user writes through it. Never returns a token.

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: google_calendar_status
